about.headline: Why Partner with RCF?
about.body: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited (RCF) is one of India's premier public sector fertilizer companies, operating under the Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers. With decades of excellence in producing quality fertilizers and industrial chemicals, RCF offers franchise partners unmatched brand trust, government backing, and a robust supply chain.
benefits: Learn about RCF's products and business opportunities
Access to partner information and application support
Training and onboarding details subject to company approval
Digital tools and portal access for easy management
